title: Retractable Wall Hook (Patent Pending), 2-1/2-Inch Extension, 15 Lb Capacity | Golden Yellow | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop losing hanging space in a small bathroom in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. This Carolina retractable wall hook extends when you need it for towels or robes, then pushes back in so it stays out of the way.

  • Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Create a coordinated traditional look — part of the Carolina collection, designed for matching Carolina classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • Customize the finishing touch — remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob to match existing hardware in the room.
  • Installs on standard interior walls — drill one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; includes toggle bolts and all mounting hardware.

Specs
Product dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
Extension / hanging space: 2-1/2"
Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
Shipping weight: 1.3 lb

_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your décor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2" of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in.
